subject_uz: Gaz haydash agregati kompressori rotorini (GTs2-519-56/1.44) texnik topshiriq asosida ta'mirlash

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik topshiriq asosida GTs2-519-56/1.44 rusumli nagnetatel rotorini ta'mirlash.
requirements.summary_en: Repair of the GTs2-519-56/1.44 compressor rotor under the technical assignment.
requirements.quote: Техник топширик асосида ГЦ2-519-56/1.44 русумли нагнетател роторини таъмирлаш

requirements.summary_uz: Rotorni kirish nazoratidan o'tkazish, tozalash va yuvish ishlarini bajarish.
requirements.summary_en: Incoming inspection, cleaning and washing of the rotor.

requirements.summary_uz: Rotor vali bo'yinchalarini naplavka qilish, termik ishlov berish, shlifovka va polirovka qilish.
requirements.summary_en: Build-up welding of the rotor shaft journals, heat treatment, grinding and polishing.
requirements.quote: 7. Rоtог vali Ьо'уiпсhаlагiпi shlifovka va polirovka qilish;

requirements.summary_uz: Yaroqsiz holatga kelgan rotor ehtiyot qismlarini yasash (qismlar ro'yxati texnik topshiriqda berilgan).
requirements.summary_en: Manufacture of rotor spare parts that are beyond repair (the list of parts is in the assignment).
requirements.quote: 8. Yaroqsiz holatga kelgan rоtоr ehtiyot qismlarini yasash.

requirements.summary_uz: Pudratchi ta'mirlashda zarur tajribaga ega ekanini, konstruktorlik hujjatlari va ishlab chiqarish bazasi borligini tasdiqlovchi hujjatlarni taqdim etishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The contractor must prove the necessary repair experience, design documentation and production base.
requirements.quote: ushbu extiyot qisrrtni ta'lTirlashda zаruг tajribaga ega ekanIigini, talab

requirements.summary_uz: Ta'mirlangan qism qabul qilishdan oldin kompressor stansiyasi mutaxassislari ko'rigidan va 72 soatlik sinovdan o'tkaziladi.
requirements.summary_en: The repaired part is accepted after inspection by the compressor station specialists and a 72-hour test.
requirements.quote: ko'rikdan o'tkazilgandan va 72 soatlik sinov o'tkazilib tekshiгilgarrdan so'ng

requirements.summary_uz: Ta'mirlangan ehtiyot qism GPA-TS-16SK kompressori bilan to'liq mos kelishi va agregat normal ishlashini ta'minlashi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The repaired part must fully fit the GPA-TS-16SK compressor and let the unit run normally.
requirements.quote: Pudratchi tomonidan ta'mirlangan extiyot qism GрА-тS-lбSК kоtтргеssогi bilan to'Iiq

requirements.summary_uz: Baholash faqat narx bo'yicha (100%); texnik mezon 2 ball bo'lib, o'tish bali 2.
requirements.summary_en: Evaluation is on price only (100%); the single technical criterion is worth 2 points with a pass mark of 2.
requirements.quote: Техник топшириқда назарда тутилган хажм, техник параметрлар ва талабларига мувофиқлиги

requirements.summary_uz: Standart malaka talablari: resurslar mavjudligi, soliq qarzi va bankrotlik yo'qligi, insofsiz ijrochilar reyestrida bo'lmaslik.
requirements.summary_en: Standard qualification: resources available, no tax debt or bankruptcy, not on the unfair-supplier register.
requirements.quote: Солиқлар ва йиғимларни тўлаш бўйича муддати ўтган қарздорликнинг мавжуд эмаслиги.
